title: Mesh-Free Weak-Form Regression for Learning Interaction Kernels from Particle Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2611.18455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose mesh-free weak-form regression for learning interaction kernels from noisy particle trajectories. Our method uses smooth test functions to avoid differentiating noisy data and empirical particle averages to avoid density reconstruction and spatial grids. We then fit sparse combinations of candidate functions, evaluating interaction terms on sampled particle pairs to avoid all-pair quadratic cost. By transferring identifiability from the mean-field limit, we prove high-probability coefficient error bounds that separate finite-particle, time-discretization, observation-noise, and pair-sampling errors, without grid-resolution or density-estimation terms. We evaluate one-dimensional (1D) Newtonian-repulsion, 2D predator-prey, and 10D distance-localized experiments. translated_title: 无网格弱形式回归：从粒子轨迹中学习相互作用核
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种无网格弱形式回归方法，用于从含噪粒子轨迹中学习相互作用核。我们的方法使用光滑测试函数以避免对含噪数据进行求导，并利用经验粒子平均值以避免密度重建和空间网格划分。随后，我们对候选函数的稀疏组合进行拟合，并在采样的粒子对上评估相互作用项，从而避免了全粒子对的二次计算代价。通过将可辨识性从平均场极限转移过来，我们证明了高概率的系数误差界，该误差界将有限粒子、时间离散化、观测噪声和粒子对采样等误差分离开来，且不包含网格分辨率或密度估计相关的误差项。我们在一维（1D）牛顿排斥、二维捕食者-猎物以及10维距离局域化的实验中进行了评估。数值结果呈现出与理论系数误差界一致的趋势。我们还将弱形式与前向差分形式同LASSO、Ridge等方法进行了比较（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无网格弱形式回归方法，可从含噪粒子轨迹中稳健高效地学习相互作用核，并给出了分离有限粒子、时间离散、观测噪声与采样误差的高概率系数误差理论界。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a mesh-free weak-form regression method to learn interaction kernels from noisy particle trajectories, with high-probability coefficient error bounds that decouple finite-particle, time-discretization, observation-noise, and pair-sampling errors.
